description:
Locators that find a beacon through the enterprise's own directory: a DNS
    name with several addresses, SRV, DNS-SD under the network's domain, a TXT
    pointer, a well-known HTTPS beacon document, a Kubernetes headless service;
    the DnsResolver SPI over the JDK's JNDI provider; the beacon document with
    its signature. JDK-only beyond the AgentSpaces API.
